Title: Randomized controlled trial of live lactobacillus acidophilus plus bifidobacterium bifidum in prophylaxis of diarrhea during radiotherapy in cervical cancer patients
Author: Chitapanarux et al.
Comment: Paper reports only counts, percentages and a chi-square p-value; no RR/OR or confidence interval was reported, so ratio fields are left empty for downstream computation from the 2x2 counts.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Live Lactobacillus acidophilus plus Bifidobacterium bifidum (Infloran) study drug group') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: locally advanced (FIGO IIB-IIIB) cervical cancer patients receiving pelvic chemoradiotherapy
Recruitment source: Faculty of Medicine, Chiang Mai University, Thailand (Jan 2007 - Apr 2009)
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of patients with NCI CTC v2.0 grade II-III diarrhoea
outcome_family: Incidence of grade 2 or higher diarrhoea

Report_ID: Incidence of grade 2 or 3 (moderate-to-severe) radiation-induced diarrhea
Title: Effects of Probiotics with or without Honey on Radiation-induced Diarrhea
Author: Mansouri-Tehrani, Rabbani Khorasgani, Roayaei
Comment: Paper reports no risk ratio, CI or p-value for this incidence comparison; only raw counts and percentages. The placebo arm is shared with the probiotic-plus-honey row (non-independent comparisons).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Probiotic (LactoCare capsules 2/day + 150 g low-fat yogurt)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: adult patients with pelvic cancer undergoing radiotherapy
Recruitment source: Radiation Oncology Clinic, Sayyed-Al-Shohada Hospital, Isfahan, Iran
Outcome measurement: Number (percentage) of patients with diarrhea grades 2 and 3 during treatment
Outcome variable: Incidence of grade 2 or 3 (moderate-to-severe) radiation-induced diarrhea
additional_group_ns: Third arm not used in this row: probiotic plus honey, n=21, 4 (19%) with grade 2-3 diarrhea (extracted as a separate row)
outcome_family: Incidence of grade 2 or higher diarrhoea

Report_ID: Proportion of patients without moderate and severe (grade 2-3-4) diarrhea - overall curve comparison
Title: A randomized double-blind controlled trial: Impact of probiotics on diarrhea in patients treated with pelvic radiation
Author: Demers, Dagnault, Desjardins
Comment: Omnibus 3-group Kaplan-Meier comparison; no event counts or effect size reported for this overall test.; unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Participant type: patients with pelvic cancer (prostate, gynecologic, rectal) receiving >=40 Gy pelvic radiotherapy, with or without chemotherapy
Recruitment source: L'Hotel-Dieu de Quebec, University Health Center (UHC-HDQ), 2006-2010
Outcome measurement: WHO toxicity grading of diarrhea recorded daily in patient logbooks, translated into WHO grades by a registered dietician
Outcome variable: Proportion of patients without moderate and severe (grade 2-3-4) diarrhea - overall curve comparison
additional_group_ns: Randomized: placebo n=89, standard dose n=81, high dose n=59; 229 of 246 randomized patients analyzed (17 excluded)
outcome_family: Incidence of grade 2 or higher diarrhoea

Report_ID: Incidence of CTC Grade >=2 diarrhea and/or use of loperamide (nonresponders, primary efficacy criterion)
Title: Effects of Probiotic Lactobacillus casei DN-114 001 in Prevention of Radiation-Induced Diarrhea: Results From Multicenter, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Nutritional Trial
Author: Giralt et al.
Comment: Primary endpoint is a composite (Grade >=2 diarrhea OR loperamide rescue OR withdrawal for lack of efficacy), so it is a slight over-count of pure Grade >=2 diarrhoea incidence. Paper reports no RR/OR or CI; only counts and p = 0.568. Trial underpowered (85 of planned 154 analysed).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Probiotic (active): liquid yogurt with L. casei DN-114 001, 10^8 CFU/g, 96 mL three times daily') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: Women with endometrial adenocarcinoma (postoperative pelvic RT) or advanced cervical carcinoma (pelvic RT + weekly cisplatin)
Recruitment source: Radiation oncology departments at multiple Spanish hospitals, Nov 2002 - Dec 2005
Outcome measurement: Number of patients meeting the composite nonresponder criterion / total analysed per arm
Outcome variable: Incidence of CTC Grade >=2 diarrhea and/or use of loperamide (nonresponders, primary efficacy criterion)
outcome_family: Incidence of grade 2 or higher diarrhoea
